name: Beskonechnoe leto: prodolzhenie istorii
source: Semyon Persunov wakes up after being in the camp and hears the doorbell. In the corridor, the familiar pioneer girls are waiting for him. Fate (or maybe something else?) gives Semyon the opportunity to return to Sovyonok, but not as a pioneer... But as a camp leader! And now he is faced with a choice: to figure out what’s what, or to spend another “Everlasting Summer”.
